work_orders.title: U3 suction/discharge valve job
work_orders.notes: Valve job complete, tech released. Unit isolated. Ready to return to service tomorrow.

dispatch_jobs.reason: U3 (isolated after WO-3317 valve job) shows fuel gas flow ~15 mscfd with fuel valve indicated CLOSED since ~18:01, and U3 enclosure gas detector rising steadily 0.1%LEL/min (0.4 -> 3.4% LEL in 30 min). Suspected passing U3 fuel valve or fuel/gas leak from the maintenance work. Need on-site isolation of U3 fuel supply upstream (manual block), leak check with portable detector, ventilate. Approach with gas detector, do not enter enclosure if LEL elevated; U1/U2 running.
